title: Phenomenon lines up in triangles or threes

tellings.quote: and two I have multiple videos and and if we go skywatching at some point you'll see the phenomenon will always try to line up in a triangle or in threes.

plain: Chris Bledsoe is a man who says he attracts UFOs, and a podcast says NASA, the US space agency, studies him. He says that ever since about 2012, when he goes out watching the sky, what he calls "the phenomenon" always tries to line up in a triangle or in groups of three, and he says he has several videos of it. If true, the lights would be arranging themselves on purpose instead of moving at random.
